name: Dr. Romantic
description: An eccentric, triple board-certified virtuoso surgeon leaves a top job in Seoul and ends up at a provincial hospital, where he mentors young doctors.

videos.title: Appendix, The Beginning of Everything
videos.overview: This prequel will show an “untold story” that viewers couldn’t see from the original episodes, and it will specifically focus on the Doldam Hospital. Gang Dong-ju and Yun Seo-jeong have their final pictures taken together as they spend their last few days together at Doldam Hospital. The letter's contents are finally revealed, which changes everything for the couple again. They're both set to their new adventures, and Teacher Kim gets the break he deserves in a long time. Teacher Kim meets a beautiful face in an unexpected place.

videos.title: How to Put an Elephant into a Fridge?
videos.overview: A heroic doctor steps in to help a distraught boy. Intern Gang Dong-ju helps Dr. Yun Seo-jeong with emergencies at Geosan University Medical Center.

videos.title: The Result of the Hypersecretion of Adrenaline
videos.overview: Dong-ju wonders whether hard work is enough to get ahead. Doldam Hospital gets a new doctor in general surgery. Seo-jeong sees a face from the past.

videos.title: Friday of 13 People
videos.overview: Dong-ju questions Teacher Kim's ways, despite his awe-inspiring skills. Seo-jeong must deal with the ramifications of her actions.

videos.title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition
videos.overview: Dong-ju finds that he's no match for Teacher Kim and becomes desperate to leave. Doldam receives a VIP visitor. Seo-jeong gets a new role.

videos.title: Principle of Relative
videos.overview: Being principled may be relative. It's all hands on deck after a major highway accident. Dong-ju tries to find out more about Teacher Kim's identity.

videos.title: Motivation
videos.overview: Teacher Kim makes demands of his own. Myeong-sim shows the staff how it's done. Associates from Seoul stop by Doldam. In-beom makes a gut call.

videos.title: Unstable Factor
videos.overview: When Doldam gets a surprise, everyone tries to cope. Dong-ju wants to know where he stands. Teacher Kim gets what he wants -- for now.

videos.title: The Manifestation of Humanism
videos.overview: A patient comes first -- no matter what. Seo-jeong gets an unexpected pep talk. Teacher Kim's compassion proves to be multilayered.

videos.title: The Boundary of Good
videos.overview: Dong-ju makes a call -- to Chairman Shin. Teacher Kim reminds Yun-wan of the importance of basics. Seo-jeong vexes an old mentor. It's Friday at Doldam.

videos.title: Crush
videos.overview: The inspector from Geosan tries to stop the Doldam staff from treating patients. But there's a multicar accident -- and a drunk driver at the scene.

videos.title: Psychological Entropy
videos.overview: Yun-wan wants to know if Dong-ju is on his side. A soldier goes missing. Seo-jeong doesn't back down, but Teacher Kim shows her how it's truly done.

videos.title: The Boiling Point
videos.overview: Dong-ju gets bad advice and faces the consequences. Seo-jeong gets put on the spot. Yun-wan dials up the pressure but Teacher Kim pushes back.

videos.title: The Art of Turmoil
videos.overview: The staff starts preparing for Chairman Shin's surgery and Seo-jeong gets her big chance. Doldam may have an epidemic on its hands.

videos.title: Paragonimiasis Effect
videos.overview: Seo-jeong volunteers to deal with a critical patient. Doldam averts a crisis. Dong-ju shows his appreciation. Teacher Kim catches In-beom's mistake.

videos.title: The Cornered Stone Syndrome
videos.overview: In a twisted world that demands blind obedience to its rules, there's no room for those with integrity and ability. Shin's surgery gets complicated.

videos.title: Burden of Risk
videos.overview: Teacher Kim plans to do the impossible, and Yun-wan will do anything to stop him. In-beom wants to do the surgery -- for the team, not his father.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: A large audience waits outside the operating room -- and not everyone wants the team to prevail. A shifty reporter starts lurking around Doldam.

videos.title: Whether You Want It or Not
videos.overview: It's only after time passes that seemingly minor moments in life start taking on greater meaning. Yun-wan gets his way -- and orders Doldam's closure.

videos.title: Doctors and Righteous People
videos.overview: Yun-wan makes sure that old wounds don't lie dormant. The furtive reporter keeps snooping around. Dong-ju confronts Teacher Kim about the past.

videos.title: The Law of Conservation of Romance
videos.overview: Teacher Kim takes the staff to Seoul. Yun-wan won't let his old rival have the spotlight. Bu Yong-ju is hurt but stands by romance and his principles.

videos.title: Rainmaker
videos.overview: During his trip to the main hospital, Teacher Kim leaves an impression — especially on three young doctors who find themselves in his hospital lobby.

videos.title: Mechanism of Accidents
videos.overview: Teacher Kim shocks Seo U-jin with his unconventional approach to saving a high-ranking official, and bans Cha Eun-jae from assisting his surgeries.

videos.title: Undefined Setting Value
videos.overview: Do Yun-wan creates chaos by bringing his own team of doctors. U-jin's participation in Park Min-guk's surgery sparks a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Utilizing Conflict
videos.overview: U-jin gets caught in the middle of two feuding teams of doctors when the family of a patient threatens to sue for malpractice.

videos.title: A Living Friday Night
videos.overview: New doctors get a taste of their first Friday at Doldam Hospital. U-jin refuses to treat a patient who triggers his childhood trauma.

videos.title: Placebo
videos.overview: Teacher Kim leads his team in saving two critical patients at the same time. Eun-jae steps in to protect a woman from her abusive husband.

videos.title: The Line that Should be Protected
videos.overview: Min-guk becomes determined to turn people away from Teacher Kim. A situation Eun-jae tries to mitigate takes a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Walk of Respect
videos.overview: Even in her final moments, a paramedic helps save another's life. U-jin shows Eun-jae his way of resetting the mind from worries.

videos.title: Trauma
videos.overview: U-jin looks into diagnoses for Teacher Kim's arm pain. A bus accident conjures up a regretful moment that haunts Min-guk's conscience.

videos.title: The Effects of an Adequate Amount of Anxiety
videos.overview: Yoon A-reum protects a patient's rape kit from falling into wrong hands. Min-guk finally brings up the bus accident from 11 years ago to Teacher Kim.

videos.title: Minimum Boundaries
videos.overview: Min-guk asserts his authority by restructuring the hospital staff. U-jin is stunned to learn which surgeon was behind a faulty operation.

videos.title: An Error of Exchange of Equivalents
videos.overview: A recruiter with bitter resentment for U-jin tries to tempt staff members to leave Doldam Hospital. Eunjae's mom asks for a favor.

videos.title: Defense Mechanism
videos.overview: Eun-jae panics when she runs out of medication from Teacher Kim before surgery. U-jin gets coerced into leaving Doldam Hospital.

videos.title: Selective Dyslexia
videos.overview: Teacher Kim tasks U-jin with a final assignment. Min-guk performs surgery on a VIP patient despite pushback from Shim Hye-jin.

videos.title: Rapport; Trust Relationship
videos.overview: Do In-beom returns to Doldam Hospital to investigate an unsuccessful surgery. Min-guk decides between his greed and the truth.

videos.title: Koi's Law
videos.overview: Bae Mun-jeong comes clean to U-jin about the connection between their families. Teacher Kim secures a safe future for Doldam Hospital.

videos.title: Break Line
videos.overview: The medical staff of Doldam Hospital fly out in a helicopter to a ship lost out at sea on behalf of Teacher Kim, who is absent on vacation.

videos.title: Between Ethics and Reality
videos.overview: As the patient's lung condition deteriorates due to tuberculosis, Teacher Kim opens the trauma centre operating room for Ri Bok-young's surgery.

videos.title: How to Put an Elephant into a Fridge? Part 2
videos.overview: Doldam Hospital hires new personnel. The people of Doldam, who thought Teacher Kim would be the new head of the trauma centre, hold an emergency meeting.

videos.title: Abracadabra
videos.overview: Patients injured in a residential fire are rushed into the emergency room. Seo U-jin treats the suspected arsonist despite Jang Dong-hwa's criticism.

videos.title: Code Clear
videos.overview: Cha Jin-man hates that Teacher Kim's methods are deeply rooted into Doldam Hospital and takes everyone except Lee Seon-ung and Dong-hwa to the trauma centre.

videos.title: Empathy & Sympathy
videos.overview: The trauma centre loses a patient and receives another patient in critical condition. Meanwhile, a child visits Teacher Kim at Doldam Hospital.

videos.title: Inciting Hope
videos.overview: Wounded soldiers are rushed to Doldam Hospital. A-reum is left alone to tend to the emergency room when rogue patients suddenly cause a scene.

videos.title: Underdog Effect
videos.overview: Patients rush into the emergency room while the staff tends to surgeries. Doldam Hospital falls into chaos as the gunman's identity is revealed.

videos.title: The Righteous Doctor Complex
videos.overview: When an old building collapses resulting in several casualties, a disaster medical support team is dispatched to the site.

videos.title: The Abuse of Justice
videos.overview: Doldam Hospital receives news of a second collapse, but the place is still full of injured people. Teacher Kim leaves everything and heads to the scene.

videos.title: The Certainty of Uncertainty
videos.overview: Go Gyeong-suk does not give up the legal battle over her son's death. She proposes a secret deal to bring down Jin-man, but Teacher Kim opposes to it.

videos.title: The Courage to be Ordinary
videos.overview: Jin-man fails to find the culprit who broke into the director's office. His reputation is further ruined as incidents from his past become known.

videos.title: The Parrotbill Paradox
videos.overview: Gang Dong-ju returns to Doldam Hospital, with his unconventional proposals causing a stir in the trauma centre.

videos.title: The Addiction to Success
videos.overview: Eun-jae performs emergency surgery on a non-trauma patient while she must join another surgery for a patient with multiple traumas.

videos.title: The Game Changer
videos.overview: People injured from a forest fire rush into Doldam Hospital. Yet, the trauma centre is empty due to the staff staging a boycott against Dong-ju.

videos.title: Dreamers
videos.overview: A fire approaches as if it would devour Doldam Hospital at any moment. Only after evacuating all the patients do the staff realise Teacher Kim was gone.
